answers.q1: Go modules, driven through the Makefile. Install dependencies with `go get -v ./...`, which is what `make install_deps` runs. `make test` and `make richtest` run it automatically. The module is `github.com/spf13/cobra`, and `go.mod` declares `go 1.15`.
answers.q2: `make test`. This runs `go get -v ./...` and then `go test -v ./...`. CI runs `make richtest`, the same thing through richgo. Without the Makefile, use `go test ./...`.
answers.q3: `go test ./doc -run 'TestGenMd' -v`. That pattern matches every test in doc/md_docs_test.go: TestGenMdDoc, TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis, TestGenMdNoHiddenParents, TestGenMdNoTag and TestGenMdTree. The pattern `-run 'TestGenMd'` also matches any other test whose name starts with TestGenMd. To run one test, use `go test ./doc -run '^TestGenMdDoc$' -v`.
answers.q4: Run `make fmt` and `make lint`. `make fmt` checks gofmt. `make lint` runs `golangci-lint run -v` with .golangci.yml, which enables gofmt, goimports, errcheck, goconst, gocritic, gosec, govet, ineffassign, misspell, nolintlint, staticcheck, unconvert and unused. CI runs `golangci-lint run --verbose` through golangci-lint-action. CI also runs a license-header check: `docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .`
answers.q5: `go.sum` is a lockfile, so don't edit it by hand; AGENTS.md lists it as the only do-not-edit file. Keep the AgentBrief-generated block in AGENTS.md between `<!-- agentbrief:start -->` and `<!-- agentbrief:end -->` untouched too. It is refreshed with `agentbrief sync`.
